headline: Approved January 7, 2026 meeting minutes as amended, 8-0
summary: The committee reviewed updates from various boards, including park rehab plans and Community Preservation Committee funding of about $530,000 for open space projects. It also discussed ongoing open space issues by ward, including trails, bridges, and sidewalk repairs, and reviewed its 2026 goals from the annual Open Space Plan. The committee approved the January 7, 2026 minutes as amended.
decisions: Approved the January 7, 2026 meeting minutes, as amended, 8-0.
